notes: Called 'U' nut in AIM; a Corvair radio U-nut listing and a 1969 Camaro A/C condenser kit (as J-nut) cite it, AMK 2014 nut catalog lists the number, but no thread size found. Searches done: 'GM 9420153 U nut', '9420153 AMK nut'; budget exhausted. | Round 4: Searched '9420153', '9420153 camaros', '9420153 J-nut'. Classic Industries A9600160 (69 Camaro A/C condenser kit) lists it as J-nut; page 403. No thread size.
